# Source: The Sumida River in Winter Snow (Fuyu Sumidagawa no yuki), from the series "Famous Places in Edo in the Four Seasons (Shiki Koto meisho)"

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** The Sumida River in Winter Snow (Fuyu Sumidagawa no yuki), from the series "Famous Places in Edo in the Four Seasons (Shiki Koto meisho)"
- **Artist / culture:** Utagawa Hiroshige 歌川 広重 Japanese, 1797-1858
- **Date:** 1834/35
- **Style:** Japanese (culture or style)
- **Classification:** woodblock print
- **Department:** Arts of Asia
- **AIC artwork ID:** 59064
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/59064
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/93ce8998-5a79-cbd0-5221-40434bcb5985/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Winter

## Extracted source palette

`#B8A878, #284848, #988858, #686848, #485858, #383828, #E8E8C8, #989878`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#152525`
- `surface`: `#303E3E`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#B8A878`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#284848`
- `surface_variant`: `#303E3E`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#556060`
- `error`: `#B8A878`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `6dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `14.92:1`, surface `10.48:1`
- Variant contrast: `10.48:1`
- Control contrast: `8.29:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
